# Mohamed Sameer | Independent Product Consultant

Cairo-based independent product consultant for founders worldwide planning to enter Saudi Arabia, Egypt or the UAE. Works in Arabic and English. Updated 25 November 2026.

## MENA Market-Entry Sprint

For founders anywhere in the world planning their first steps in Saudi Arabia, Egypt or the UAE. Best fit for fintech and SaaS products.

A market study covers likely buyers, evidence of demand, competitors and pricing. A general legal and licensing overview identifies questions to confirm with a local adviser. A 90-day entry plan covers first customers, potential partners, hiring and budget. The sprint takes 14 days and includes a PDF and a one-hour call. Mohamed and the founder agree on one fixed price of USD 500–800 before work begins. To arrange a 20-minute introductory call, email mohamedsameercontact@gmail.com.

## Profile

10+ years in digital products across fintech and SaaS. Independent practice since September 2023. Mohamed is also a Product Manager at Lahint, a Gulf fintech, where he builds and tests payment products for Arabic and English users. 18 completed Upwork jobs.

## Selected work

- **Independent practice / Upwork, Product Manager and Independent Consultant (September 2023–present):** Product strategy, MVP definition, SaaS and AI-enabled product advisory, and delivery coordination for international clients. Defined embedded-finance use cases and MVP scope for a Saudi client across four delivery milestones.
- **Lahint, Product Management Consultant, July–August 2026.** Compared vendor proposals against requirements for the consumer and merchant apps and clarified expected deliverables. Remote contract.
- **Lahint, Product Manager, September 2026–present.** Part-time, remote from Cairo. Defines credit, payment and repayment rules. Built bilingual prototypes to trace simulated purchases across confirmation, receipts and history. Compared 357 screens and states against requirements, visually inspected 15 frames in detail and recorded 26 prioritized findings and 8 coverage gaps.
- **Selected projects.** Saudi embedded-finance MVP scope across four milestones, an AI product direction audit, personalized audio feedback and playback QA, B2B ordering, and a fictional scheduling UAT example in the work samples.
- **SilverKey Technologies, Product Manager (September 2022–March 2026):** Owned six products under one roadmap: consumer app, merchant portal, corporate portal, mobile wallet, bill payments and digital lending. Led a cross-functional Agile team of 12+ from discovery through UAT and release. Owned lending and BNPL workflows, configurable credit eligibility and approval rules, and card, wallet, bill-payment and merchant-acquiring integrations.
- **Scicom X, Product Manager (November 2021–February 2022):** Managed a subscription content platform across web and mobile and an Arabic newsletter tool, covering subscriptions, editorial workflows, templates and retention analytics.
- **Tawasol Academy, Product Manager (April–July 2020, contract):** Validated an education content product through research and A/B testing. Launched a livestreaming service that reached millions of organic views in its first two weeks.
- **Tqweem Masr, Founding Product Manager (January 2017–December 2019):** Built the product function across authoring tools, the learning platform and administration systems. Launched a B2B schools programme generating more than $50,000 in annual revenue after its first year. Achieved 60% user growth from Q1 2018 to Q4 2018 using less than 30% of the previous year's budget.
- **AlMunif Holding, Product Management Consultant (July–September 2019):** Remote contract for a Saudi holding company spanning retail, food, logistics and distribution.
- **Cournal Agency, Digital Account Manager (May 2016–July 2018):** Managed 10+ clients remotely across Europe and the GCC, coordinating campaigns, creative delivery and performance reporting.
- **S3Geeks, Product Strategist and Executive Officer (June 2011–January 2017):** Led distributed teams and regional programmes. Executive Officer from April 2016; represented the organisation at a World Bank conference in Marseille in 2016.

## Consulting services

- **MVP discovery and scope**. Bring the idea, the constraints and the people who will use it. I map the essential journey and help you choose a first release your team can estimate.
- **Vendor and product reviews**. Give me competing proposals, designs or a working prototype. I compare each one with the brief and identify the gaps that could change your decision.
- **Prototyping and delivery support**. I work with your team to turn open decisions into an interactive prototype, then test what happens across roles, languages and failure states.

## Tools

Codex, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini; Jira, Confluence, ProductPlan; Figma, Miro, Balsamiq; Mixpanel, Amplitude, Google Analytics, Hotjar and Microsoft Clarity.
